note: Client verdict on the baseline: NOT VERY PLAYABLE. Structural, so the fix is structural. Two changes followed. (1) A tenth law, L10 THE CORE LOOP: a detector firing now opens a timed OUTBREAK, drawn where it happened and named in plain words, which the player must answer with the right institution before the fuse runs out. No piece can be marked won while L10 scores below 8. (2) The client supplied the real source paper, which the egress proxy had blocked. Its four sections ARE the table's four families, the 117 target turns out to be a direct citation, and it hands us the decision the game was missing: institutions TRADE OFF rather than upgrade. LEDGER catches the liar and teaches the colony to ignore the lone dissenter; LENS reveals everything including the rumour. Sub-agent concurrency is capped at 2 on this box, so the seven pieces are consolidated into five.

pieces.name: PLAY — the outbreak loop and the hands that drive it
pieces.judged: L10 the core loop above all: a decision every few seconds, a knowable right answer, immediate located consequence, real answerable time pressure, mastery that accumulates. Then L4 tiny interaction surface and L8 one clear next action, 44px thumb targets.

rounds.built: Architecture built: build.js concatenates 12 parts into one formicary.html and hard-gates the constraints. Boots clean, no page errors, hygiene clean at 320/390/430.
rounds.gap: THE CORE LOOP DOES NOT EXIST. 45-outbreak.js is still a 21-line stub; tryAnswer() returns false unconditionally. A player watches dots drift and is never asked to do anything.

rounds.built: The outbreak loop is real and measured. A scripted competent player took 47 actions in 90 seconds — one decision every 1.9s — and survived at strain 7.5; hands-off, the same chapter hits strain 100 in 21.8s. Fuse is ~6.7s, floored at 2.8s, and scales with machine speed. A wrong instrument gives the plain diagnosis AND auto-opens the element card with its counter chip lit. A miss draws a scar at the exact spot, stuns the nearest workers and spikes strain. Mastery persists in localStorage.
rounds.gap: Two failures. (1) Name plates collide: the ring's own label reads Sa while the ticker sentence belongs to In, and three plates stack with one half-occluded — so the player cannot tell which failure they are being asked to answer. (2) An exploit: ejecting an HONEST worker inside a burning Sa ring returns ANSWERED and refunds, while strain actually goes UP. A bot banked 11 correct Sa answers and gutted the colony from 16 workers to 4.

pieces.name: TEACH — the ten-chapter sequence
pieces.judged: L1 one new idea at a time, L2 play first name second, L6 run it again and see (the chapter 4 A/B), L8 no dead time, L9 the sandbox is the reward

rounds.built: Ten chapters wired. Verified by probe: chapter 0 has 4 workers, no tool bar, no table cells and zero enabled elements; chapter 9 enables all 28 with all 6 tools and a 117 goal. Progress rail present throughout.
rounds.gap: Not yet independently judged — deferred to round 2 so round 1 could concentrate on the playability verdict.

pieces.name: READ — field and table legibility
pieces.judged: L3 the causal beat visible, immediate and co-located; L7 readable at 390px; can a stranger read the field in three seconds; does a lit cell point at bodies on the field

rounds.built: Field renders workers as 7px discs with state shown by shape not colour, jobs sized by value with progress fill, and a causal ticker under the field. Table draws all 28 cells with untaught ones as dashed ghosts, so the taxonomy visibly fills in as you learn it.
rounds.gap: Not yet independently judged — deferred to round 2.

pieces.name: WORLD — 28 detectors, trade-offs, balance
pieces.judged: audit.js all 28 fire with working counters; CONTRACT section 15 trade-offs actually implemented and felt; conflicts resolve into force/passivity/truce/unsettled; speed raises throughput AND aggression; ch9 losable but winnable

rounds.built: All 28 detectors live and measured. AUDIT: PASS — 28 defined, none dead, no broken counters, counterWorks measured by comparing heat slope with the counter off vs on for the same seed, 12s for 6 trials x 40000 ticks. Determinism verified byte-identical per seed. Ch9 dies ungoverned in ~45s and reaches 117/117 when played well. 18 force keys documented so teaching chapters can guarantee their lesson.
rounds.gap: CONTRACT section 15 trade-offs are not implemented — they were written after this was built. Every institution is still a strictly-good purchase, so the optimal strategy is just to buy everything as budget allows. That is the missing decision.

rounds.built: All six section-15 trade-offs implemented and proven empirically in the audit — same seed, instrument off vs on, showing the intended element fall and the traded-off element rise. AUDIT: PASS with 28 live detectors. L6 scored 9, the highest single law of the round.
rounds.gap: The strain economy cannot punish. Passive drain is a flat -3 strain per second, so a landed outbreak's damage evaporates in about two seconds, and budget sits pinned at its cap. Worse: the ch9 balance numbers were measured with the core loop switched off entirely, so they do not describe the game anyone actually plays.

pieces.name: SHELL — visual system and voice
pieces.judged: L5 plainspoken warm funny voice, palette and typographic discipline, no layout break 320-430px, the real research facts landing as content rather than footnotes

rounds.built: IBM Plex Mono subsetted and embedded as base64 so the deliverable is genuinely one file with no network. Palette and no-border-radius gates pass. No horizontal scroll, no sub-30px targets.
rounds.gap: The layout wastes half the phone. On chapter 0 the bottom 45 percent is empty white with two narrator lines floating in a void. Also the black field against the white page reads as two different applications stitched together.

rounds.built: Best score of the round. Layout now adapts to what a chapter contains. Constraints verified independently against the built file: zero border-radius, zero pictographic codepoints, palette exact, IBM Plex Mono embedded.
rounds.gap: The taxonomy names are illegible. Element names render at 7.2px and are ellipsis-truncated in six of 28 cells at 390px — COORDINATION..., SYNCHRONIZED..., MISSING MENTAL... The vocabulary the whole piece exists to teach is below the 11px floor and, for six entries, literally cut off on the target device.
